from fractions import Fraction

lo=(2,2,2,0,0); hi=(5,5,5,5,5)
def wt(x): return sum(x)
def parts(d,n=5,mx=5):
    out=[]
    def rec(pre,last,rem):
        if len(pre)==n:
            if rem==0: out.append(tuple(pre))
            return
        for z in range(min(last,rem),-1,-1): rec(pre+[z],z,rem-z)
    rec([],mx,d)
    return [x for x in out if all(lo[k]<=x[k]<=hi[k] for k in range(n))]
def horiz(lam,mu):
    return all(lam[k]<=mu[k] for k in range(5)) and all(lam[k]>=mu[k+1] for k in range(4))
def matrix(d):
    cols=parts(d); rows=[]; labels=[]
    for t in range(1,6):
        for lam in parts(d-t):
            rows.append([int(horiz(lam,mu)) for mu in cols]); labels.append((t,lam))
    return rows,cols,labels
def solve(A,b):
    m=len(A); n=len(A[0]) if m else 0
    R=[[Fraction(x) for x in A[i]]+[Fraction(b[i])] for i in range(m)]
    piv=[]; r=0
    for c in range(n):
        q=next((u for u in range(r,m) if R[u][c]),None)
        if q is None: continue
        R[r],R[q]=R[q],R[r]
        z=R[r][c]; R[r]=[v/z for v in R[r]]
        for u in range(m):
            if u!=r and R[u][c]:
                z=R[u][c]; R[u]=[R[u][v]-z*R[r][v] for v in range(n+1)]
        piv.append(c); r+=1
        if r==m: break
    assert all(any(R[u][c] for c in range(n)) or not R[u][n] for u in range(m))
    x=[Fraction(0) for _ in range(n)]
    for u,c in enumerate(piv): x[c]=R[u][n]
    return x
def det(A):
    n=len(A)
    if n==0: return 1
    B=[row[:] for row in A]; sign=1; prev=1
    for k in range(n-1):
        q=next((u for u in range(k,n) if B[u][k]!=0),None)
        if q is None:return 0
        if q!=k:B[k],B[q]=B[q],B[k]; sign=-sign
        pivot=B[k][k]
        for i in range(k+1,n):
            for j in range(k+1,n): B[i][j]=(B[i][j]*pivot-B[i][k]*B[k][j])//prev
        prev=pivot
        for i in range(k+1,n): B[i][k]=0
    return sign*B[-1][-1]

GL=[(2,2,2),(2,2,2,1),(2,2,2,2),(2,2,2,1,1),(2,2,2,2,1),(2,2,2,2,2)]
GR=[(2,2,2),(3,2,2),(4,2,2),(3,3,2),(4,3,2),(4,4,2)]
M6,C6,L6=matrix(6)
assert M6==[] and C6==[(2,2,2,0,0)] and L6==[]
print('boundary degree=6 M_shape=0x1 quotient_basis=[[2,2,2,0,0]]')
blocks=[]
for d in range(6,11):
    M,cols,labels=matrix(d); n=len(cols); m=len(M)
    gl=[x for x in GL if wt(x)==d]; gr=[x for x in GR if wt(x)==d]
    gi=[cols.index(x+(0,)*(5-len(x))) for x in gl]
    ri=[cols.index(x+(0,)*(5-len(x))) for x in gr]
    A=[]
    for c in range(n):
        A.append([M[u][c] for u in range(m)]+[int(c==z) for z in gi])
    T=[]; ws=[]
    for q in ri:
        x=solve(A,[int(c==q) for c in range(n)])
        rel=x[:m]; a=x[m:]
        assert all(z.denominator==1 for z in x)
        T.append([int(z) for z in a])
        ws.append([((labels[u][0],labels[u][1]),int(rel[u])) for u in range(m) if rel[u]])
    TT=[[T[j][i] for j in range(len(T))] for i in range(len(gl))]
    dd=det(TT)
    assert abs(dd)==1
    blocks.append((d,gl,gr,TT,dd,ws))
    print('degree',d)
    print('GL',gl,'GR',gr)
    print('T_rows_GL_cols_GR',TT)
    print('det',dd,'SNF',[1]*len(gl))
    print('witnesses_GR_order',ws)
Tbig=[[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]
for d,gl,gr,T,dd,ws in blocks:
    for i,g in enumerate(gl):
        for j,r in enumerate(gr): Tbig[GL.index(g)][GR.index(r)]=T[i][j]
print('global_T_rows_GL_cols_GR',Tbig)
print('global_det',det(Tbig),'global_SNF',[1]*6)
print('natural_order_upper_unitriangular',all(Tbig[i][i]==1 for i in range(6)) and all(Tbig[i][j]==0 for i in range(6) for j in range(i)))
print('natural_order_lower_unitriangular',all(Tbig[i][i]==1 for i in range(6)) and all(Tbig[i][j]==0 for i in range(6) for j in range(i+1,6)))
